candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Portuguese grammatical articles, prepositions, and pronouns.
This feature vector represents words and roots common in Romance languages, particularly Portuguese, French, and Italian, related to significance, inclusion, and main concepts.
This vector represents words, roots, and inflections beginning with the Spanish or Portuguese prefix/root "est-".
This feature vector represents adjectives and adverbs indicating variety, difference, and significance across Romance languages.
This vector represents common Portuguese verb roots, temporal markers, and connective adverbs.
These tokens represent telephone area codes in the United States and Canada.
This feature vector represents common Portuguese nominal and verbal suffixes or root endings.
This vector represents descriptive adjectives, particularly those denoting ease, difficulty, necessity, or quality across multiple languages.
This vector represents nationalities, regions, and cultural or historical styles.
This feature vector represents Spanish and French verb roots related to actions, behaviors, and mental processes.
